2026-08-01.title: Let God Lead the Way
2026-08-01.verse: Make me understand your ways, O Lord. Teach me your paths. Guide me into your truth and teach me. For you are the God who delivers me; on you I rely all day long.
2026-08-01.observation: We think of God’s Word like a map that we follow, and there is a lot of truth in it. However, God’s Word says that it is a lamp for our feet and a light for our path. This means God’s Word gives us an overall idea of what is happening, but He mostly shines on our next step. In today’s song, the psalmist is asking God to lead the way because all his hope is in the Lord. This is the way to live, but it is also important to realize that we live according to the guidance of the Lord in the way He wants to do it. We can become discouraged if we ask God to lead the way and then He leads in a way that is different from what we would want. We may ask God to show us our whole lives in advance, but He has us settle for the next step. We must trust that God has His reasons and let Him lead.
2026-08-01.application: Ask God to lead the way today and then trust Him to do so in His own way.
2026-08-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us through following Your Word.

2026-08-02.title: Live According to Truth
2026-08-02.verse: Examine me, O Lord, and test me. Evaluate my inner thoughts and motives. For I am ever aware of your faithfulness, and your loyalty continually motivates me.
2026-08-02.observation: It is important that we live according to truth and not according to our emotions. If we lived according to our emotions, life would be a literal roller coaster. Emotions are fun. They bring spice to life. They remind us that the moments we walk through in life are good, bad, fun, sad, and everything in between. However, we cannot think of emotions as the compass for our lives. Someone can be saying something true, but if they say it in a harsh way we can assume it is wrong. On the other hand, if someone says something nice, we can assume it is true. We must live according to the truths of God’s Word so we can have an accurate compass in life. Times, seasons, cultures, and people change, but God’s Word stays steady.
2026-08-02.application: Commit to reading God’s Word every day as the Source of Truth in your life.
2026-08-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us in the right direction.

2026-08-03.title: The Lord is Greater Than Fear
2026-08-03.verse: By David. The Lord is my light and my salvation. I fear no one. The Lord protects my life. I am afraid of no one.
2026-08-03.observation: When my girls were little, they enjoyed going to the zoo. It was funny to watch how they would be so interested in the animals, but they would always look to make sure I was not nervous. They would look at the big elephants, look at me to make sure I was smiling, and then they would enjoy the moment. Sometimes they would ask and make sure they couldn’t get out, and then have fun. This is what it is like to be a Christian. We look at the difficulties and troubles of life, then remember our Heavenly Father is not worried. This gives us hope and confidence to smile at every problem. That doesn’t mean we take them lightly or that we do not get concerned. It simply means we do not live in fear because we know our Heavenly Father is not worried. Therefore, we don’t have to be worried either.
2026-08-03.application: What fear do you need to hand to your Heavenly Father today, remembering that He is greater than your fear?
2026-08-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us courage.

2026-08-04.title: The Lord Helps Us
2026-08-04.verse: The Lord strengthens and protects me; I trust in him with all my heart. I am rescued and my heart is full of joy; I will sing to him in gratitude.
2026-08-04.observation: The Lord is our help in all times, especially in our times of need. When we realize this, we can have great joy. We can sing songs of thankfulness because we realize that we have a great God who is always able and willing to help when we need Him the most. Have you ever met someone who finally becomes financially secure for the first time in a long time? I walked with someone who had made some bad choices earlier in their life. Because of this, they had to deal with a lot of debt and went through a season where they were homeless. They were constantly behind on their payments and were constantly in fear of losing all they had. However, he worked hard and slowly started making progress. When I knew him, he finally paid off the last of his debts, and secured a job that would adequately pay all his bills. The relief on his face is indescribable. He felt as though he finally had peace. This is like the feeling we can experience when we realize that an endless supply of hope is available. We don’t have to figure it all out on our own anymore. The Lord is with us. He walks with us. He leads and guides us. This doesn’t mean we won’t face future hardships and difficulties. The good news is we no longer have to go through this feeling as though we are alone. There is an endless supply of God’s help in time of need. That help comes in many different ways, but it always comes.
2026-08-04.application: Take a moment and think about the fact you are not facing anything alone. The Lord is with you. He is already helping you more than you realize.
2026-08-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us in more ways than we will ever realize.

2026-08-05.title: Strength Comes From the Lord
2026-08-05.verse: The Lord sits enthroned over the engulfing waters; the Lord sits enthroned as the eternal king. The Lord gives his people strength; the Lord grants his people security.
2026-08-05.observation: I was once helping some friends move. They had a little boy no more than about 5 years old who really wanted to help the men carry the heavy furniture. His father let him walk alongside us as we carried the heavy couches and appliances to the moving truck. While we would walk, he would have his hand on the side and say, “Dad, look at how strong I am.” The truth was he was probably causing more of a hassle than helping, but his patient dad would say, “You’re doing great. Keep going.” I wonder if the Lord sees us like that. We walk around thinking that we are doing it all, when the Lord is the one doing the “heavy lifting.” We serve a great God who controls all things. Not only that, but we could not even exist without His kindness. Every heartbeat, breath, and movement all belong to Him. He gives us the strength to do it all. What an amazing God we serve.
2026-08-05.application: Take a moment and think of all God is doing just so you can read this right now. May we always remember His kindness is all around us.
2026-08-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for doing more than we will ever imagine.

2026-08-06.title: Joy is on the Way
2026-08-06.verse: Then you turned my lament into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and covered me with joy. So now my heart will sing to you and not be silent; O Lord my God, I will always give thanks to you.
2026-08-06.observation: Following the Lord brings joy. Joy is not the same thing as happiness. Happiness is based on happenings in our lives. Joy is the settled confidence that the Lord is in control. This song says that the Lord has turned my mourning into “settled confident” dancing. We can have a settled confidence that God is in control in our darkest moments. It does not say that the Lord always takes us out of the reason we were previously wearing clothes of mourning. It says He replaces those clothes with joy. We can have peace, hope, and joy in any situation when we realize the Lord is in control. He loves us. He is working things out for us. Our job is to trust Him, follow Him, and keep holding on. Joy is on the way.
2026-08-06.application: Walk through today with the settled confidence that the Lord is in control.
2026-08-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking ahead of us and preparing the way.

2026-08-07.title: Trusting God with the Future
2026-08-07.verse: But I trust in you, O Lord! I declare, “You are my God!” You determine my destiny. Rescue me from the power of my enemies and those who chase me.
2026-08-07.observation: The song writer says, “My future is in your hands.” Imagine you were on trial and lost your case. After the verdict comes the moment when the judge announces sentencing. This is a difficult moment for the accused because their future is no longer in their hands. It is now in the hands of an impartial judge who has to decide their fate. If this were you, would you want a disinterested judge or would you want your best friend? This is how it is when a Christian thinks about the future. They can do their best and make the best decisions they can, but they cannot control the future. However, they realize the Lord is in control of the future. So, they rest in knowing that the One who gets to make the decision is the one who knows them the most and loves them the most. This is the best place to be.
2026-08-07.application: Take a moment and realize the Lord is in control of the future. This does not mean bad things won’t happen today. It means that the Lord knows, He is working out a plan, and He is with you every step of the way. He is not a disinterested third party.
2026-08-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for holding our future in Your hands.

2026-08-08.title: The Joy of Confession
2026-08-08.verse: Then I confessed my sin; I no longer covered up my wrongdoing. I said, “I will confess my rebellious acts to the Lord.” And then you forgave my sins. (Selah)
2026-08-08.observation: My daughters and I all have something in common. When we were little, we would do anything in order to not admit we had done something wrong. We also have in common that it was because we feared what would come next. There were so many times that my daughters would lie their way into a corner because they were terrified of getting in trouble. At some point, the lies would become silly and I would encourage them to just tell the truth. Finally, when they did and realized that the just punishment was nowhere near as bad as the guilt they were experiencing, it was a great relief. I couldn’t say too much because I did the same thing. I would be so afraid of what was going to happen when my parents found out I had done something wrong. Then, my fear would increase when thinking they would not only know I had done something wrong, but also that I had lied. We can sometimes feel this way about God. However, the songwriter says when he finally confessed his sins, the result was forgiveness. The greatest joy of confession is no longer walking in fear, darkness, and guilt. Do you have something heavy you are carrying? I can make you a promise. When you come to your Heavenly Father, you will not receive condemnation. You will experience the joy of forgiveness.
2026-08-08.application: Take time today and bring any sin in your life to the Lord. Experience the joy of forgiveness.
2026-08-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the joy of repentance.

2026-08-09.title: The Lord Has Your Six
2026-08-09.verse: Look, the Lord takes notice of his loyal followers, those who wait for him to demonstrate his faithfulness by saving their lives from death and sustaining them during times of famine. We wait for the Lord; he is our deliverer and shield. For our hearts rejoice in him, for we trust in his holy name.
2026-08-09.observation: In the military, they will use the positions on a clock to express direction. For example, twelve o’clock is straight ahead, three o’clock is to the right, and nine o’clock is to the left. The one that sometimes matters the most is six o’clock. That is what is directly behind you. We always need someone to “watch our six.” We need someone who can see what we cannot see, can watch our blind spots, and protect us where we are vulnerable. As a military warrior, David would understand the need for a faithful friend who is watching our six and serving as a shield for us. While God is King over all, He also walks with us and watches over us. There is no one better to watch over our soul and guard our six.
2026-08-09.application: Live today with the confidence that the Lord is guarding and protecting you in ways you will never see.
2026-08-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for guarding us in so many ways.

2026-08-10.title: Godly Fear
2026-08-10.verse: Fear the Lord, you chosen people of his, for those who fear him lack nothing.
2026-08-10.observation: It is possible to organize fear into two different categories. There is the kind of fear that causes you to back up and guard yourself and the kind of fear that is out of a sense of respect and wonder. In the times of kings and queens, those in their kingdom were to fear their ruler. Yes, it could be because of his immense power, but hopefully it was because of the way he wielded it. He had all the power he could want, yet he was good and gentle with his subjects. This is the kind of fear we should have with God. There is a natural reality that we have a healthy fear of what God could do, but we have a reverent fear of God because of what He does do. He is good. He is kind. He is patient. He is gentle. He is strong. He is close to us all.
2026-08-10.application: Think about all God could do, but how carefully He walks with us. He is a good King.
2026-08-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so good.

2026-08-11.title: Don’t Rejoice Over the Troubles of Others
2026-08-11.verse: May those who rejoice in my troubles be totally embarrassed and ashamed. May those who arrogantly taunt me be covered with shame and humiliation. May those who desire my vindication shout for joy and rejoice. May they continually say, “May the Lord be praised, for he wants his servant to be secure.
2026-08-11.observation: In the secular world, people celebrate the misfortunes of others. When someone has a negative opinion, people celebrate when that person is blasted or “put in their place.” In the kingdom of God, we realize that judgment comes and just judgment is good. The challenge is it comes from the Lord. Therefore, we do not celebrate the judgment of others. We trust the Lord and realize that, if not for the grace of God, it could be us. We realize that most people are not pure evil. Most people are broken. Hurting people hurt people. Their brokenness has brought them to that place. We pray for the Lord to have mercy and bring healing to their life. In doing so, we remember when God had mercy on us, too.
2026-08-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for teaching us to have a little of the mercy You continually show to us.

2026-08-12.title: Be Careful of the Whispers of Sin
2026-08-12.verse: For the music director, an oracle, written by the Lord’s servant David. An evil man is rebellious to the core. He does not fear God, for he is too proud to recognize and give up his sin.
2026-08-12.observation: Sin whispers. It whispers when we are alone. It whispers when we are weak. It whispers when we are tired, afraid, feeling rejected, and bored. Sin constantly tells us we can find all we desire within its arms. In the book of Proverbs, Solomon likens folly to an adulterous woman. He says that the idea of sin sounds good for a moment, but there is a cost we do not ever want to pay. He says that the adulterous woman has a husband. When he comes looking for you, the only thing that will satisfy his anger is vengeance. He says the consequences of sin are the same. Sin seems good at the moment, but it will always take us farther than we want to go and cost us more than we want to pay.
2026-08-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for keeping us far from sin.

2026-08-13.title: Two Keys for the Good Life
2026-08-13.verse: Trust in the Lord and do what is right. Settle in the land and maintain your integrity. Then you will take delight in the Lord, and he will answer your prayers. Commit your future to the Lord. Trust in him, and he will act on your behalf.
2026-08-13.observation: Two times David says the key to living a good life involves doing good or committing everything you do to the Lord and trusting the Lord. If we think about it like a garden, doing good or committing our ways to the Lord is like planting the seed. We plant acts of kindness and doing things that please the Lord. Trusting in the Lord is like watering the seed. We trust the Lord will use our good deeds for His glory and our good. Then, we wait to see what happens. The results will be a harvest of God’s goodness in our lives. It is important to realize that the good life is not a perfect life. We still have challenges and issues to walk through in this fallen world. The good life is a life of joy and consistently seeing God move in all we do.
2026-08-13.application: Serve God. Trust God. Watch what happens.
2026-08-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the good life as we follow You.

2026-08-14.title: Cry Out to God
2026-08-14.verse: Do not abandon me, O Lord. My God, do not remain far away from me. Hurry and help me, O Lord, my deliverer.
2026-08-14.observation: There are many songs where David teaches us how to not lean on our own strength but to cry out to the Lord. If the king of the nation cries out to God like this, it is no disrespect for us to do the same. Many times, when we are going through difficulties, we can forget the Lord is there. We forget that He cares more about our situation than we do. So, the next time you go through a difficult season, make an appointment in your schedule for the Lord that is outside your normal devotional time. Act as though you are having an additional meeting that day and spend it with the Lord. Tell Him about all your issues and situations. Watch as the peace of God comes over you. Watch as you realize He is able to do more than you can about it. Then, take next steps with the confidence of knowing the Lord is making a way.
2026-08-14.application: Make an appointment with God and tell Him all about it.
2026-08-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for caring for us.

2026-08-16.title: Watch Your Words
2026-08-16.verse: For the music director, Jeduthun; a psalm of David. I decided, “I will watch what I say and make sure I do not sin with my tongue. I will put a muzzle over my mouth while in the presence of an evil person.
2026-08-16.observation: The Psalmist is talking about the need to watch what we say and do. This is easy to say but not easy to do. The songwriter says the more he tried, the harder it became. In the end, he needed God to help him deal with the issues that were making it so difficult. This includes his personal inability to follow through because of his humanity. This is still true of us today. When I was a teenager, I decided I was going to not say anything at all if it was not uplifting. It lasted about 3 days and was so hard that I still remember it all these years later. Watching what we do is also difficult. However, the great news is the Lord does not intend for us to do this by ourselves. He will walk with us and move in our lives. He is with us and will help us all along the way.
2026-08-16.application: Ask God to help you bring life through your words and comfort through your actions today.
2026-08-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through our daily sanctification.

2026-08-17.title: The Lord Always Has a Plan
2026-08-17.verse: O Lord, my God, you have accomplished many things; you have done amazing things and carried out your purposes for us. No one can thwart you. I want to declare your deeds and talk about them, but they are too numerous to recount.
2026-08-17.observation: When people find out that I have plans for various things, they don’t know what to think. I have plans and systems for most things. I eat the same things, watch and read the same things, go the same places, and even change out my razors on specific days. These plans are systems in my life that keep everything moving in the right direction. When I miss something and don’t know what to do, it drives me crazy. This is one of the many reasons why I am in awe of God. He doesn’t miss anything. There is never a time when you will pray and God will say He hasn’t heard about that yet. You never have to explain a situation to Him, unless you want to. He already knows and is already working things out. We have a good God who is doing more than we know.
2026-08-17.application: Trust God’s plans in your life, even if you don’t see them.
2026-08-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for having a plan for every day of our lives.

2026-08-18.title: Kindness Pays Off
2026-08-18.verse: For the music director, a psalm of David. How blessed is the one who treats the poor properly. When trouble comes, may the Lord deliver him. May the Lord protect him and save his life. May he be blessed in the land. Do not turn him over to his enemies.
2026-08-18.observation: We have to be careful that we never serve others so that we think we are creating an obligation from God. He does not owe us anything. At the same time, He blesses those who are kind toward others. When my girls were little, it blessed my heart when I would see them be kind to someone else without being told to do so. When I saw them reach out and do something kind for someone else, it brought so much joy to my heart that I wanted to bless them for it. The extra bonus was when they didn’t think I was watching. Then, I knew it was out of a good heart that they blessed someone else. God is a lot like that, only so much greater. When we are kind and serve others, it blesses the heart of God, and His kindness is toward us.
2026-08-18.application: Do something kind for someone today.
2026-08-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us what true kindness looks like.

2026-08-19.title: The Antidote for Discouragement
2026-08-19.verse: Why are you depressed, O my soul? Why are you upset? Wait for God! For I will again give thanks to my God for his saving intervention.
2026-08-19.observation: We all go through seasons of sadness and discouragement. There are many reasons for this. Sadness can come from unmet expectations, betrayal, the loss of a friend, or simply a delayed promise. Sadness and discouragement are part of the human condition. They are usually the result of something negative that has happened beyond our ability to control. The good news is we do not have to allow these emotions to dominate us. When we place our hope in God and remember His goodness, we are able to place the results of those bad situations in His hands. We can remember the Lord is with us, for us, and moving in more ways than we can see. Placing our hope in God gives us an endless amount of hope in the most hopeless situation. We never have to be without hope when we know the Lord is still in control.
2026-08-19.application: When discouraged, take it to the Lord. Remember that He is moving. Thank Him for all the ways He has come through before.
2026-08-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always doing more than we realize.

2026-08-20.title: Remind Yourself of Where Hope Is Found
2026-08-20.verse: Why are you depressed, O my soul? Why are you upset? Wait for God! For I will again give thanks to my God for his saving intervention.
2026-08-20.observation: Everyone loves a good friend. We all need someone who can watch our back, share our journey, and someone we can process life with. Friends are valuable gifts from God that we often take for granted. One of the great things that friends can do is to give us perspective. They can remind us that, from where they stand, things look different. The problem is, friends are not always around. Friends cannot always see into the depths of our soul and know the true state of how things are. Because of this, we cannot rely only on someone else to help us remember God’s goodness. We must constantly talk to ourselves. Sometimes, we need to find a mirror and talk to ourselves like a best friend would. We need to remind ourselves that the Lord is with us, the Lord is for us, and our hope comes from Him. So, find a place alone and talk to yourself like a best friend would. Remind yourself of all the Lord has done and is doing. Why are you so discouraged? The Lord has been with you thus far. Put your hope in Him.
2026-08-20.application: Remind yourself that true hope comes from the Lord.
2026-08-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the true hope that we need.

2026-08-21.title: He Is Always There
2026-08-21.verse: As for me, I will call out to God, and the Lord will deliver me. During the evening, morning, and noontime I will lament and moan, and he will hear me.
2026-08-21.observation: Everyone needs at least one friend. The problem is no earthly friend can always be there. I’ve watched people on phone calls for hours with one another. They don’t even talk for long stretches of time. They just sit and enjoy sharing space with each other. There is nothing wrong with this, but eventually that phone call ends. One of the great things about God is the phone call never ends. He is always there. He is always with us. He is always close by. So today, when your phone call ends or if you need someone to share your heart with, always remember the Lord is near.
2026-08-21.application: Take time today to talk to the Lord.
2026-08-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being available and always being close to us.

2026-08-22.title: God Blesses Those Who Love What’s Right
2026-08-22.verse: You love justice and hate evil. For this reason God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy, elevating you above your companions.
2026-08-22.observation: Have you ever had that friend who loved to quietly cut corners? They would wink at you while they clocked back in from break but sat down instead of going back to work. Maybe they would grab two of something rather than one when the sign clearly asked everyone to take only one. Have you ever been that friend? God’s Word says that He blesses those who love what is right and despise what is evil. This can seem easy when we think of the great evils in the world or the need for great justice. However, God also sees the little moments when no one else is looking. Those are the hard choices. He sees us in those moments. Be the person who has integrity in the little things and watch what the Lord will do.
2026-08-22.application: Walk today like the Lord is right beside you. How does it affect how you live?
2026-08-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always growing us and walking us toward freedom.

2026-08-23.title: God Is Found In Stillness
2026-08-23.verse: He says, “Stop your striving and recognize that I am God. I will be exalted over the nations! I will be exalted over the earth!” The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is on our side! The God of Jacob is our stronghold! (Selah)
2026-08-23.observation: Have you ever been in such a rush you did not notice something right in front of you? Recently, my wife asked my youngest daughter to put something on her phone. While my daughter worked on it, my wife started looking around. She finally said with slight frustration, “Has anyone seen my phone?” She was busy and hurried. It caused her not to be able to see what was in front of her or what had happened just a few minutes before. This is what hurry does to us with the Lord. It causes us not to be able to see the Lord working or what His Word has told us just a few minutes before. This is the power of stillness. When we slow down long enough to look for the Lord, we will find Him moving everywhere.
2026-08-23.application: Take 10 minutes today and find a place to be still. Let your mind clear and think on the goodness of God. If you’re not used to this, 10 minutes will feel like a long time. Stick with it and watch what happens.
2026-08-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being more active than we realize.

2026-08-24.title: God Rules It All
2026-08-24.verse: For the Lord Most High is awe-inspiring; he is the great king who rules the whole earth!
2026-08-24.observation: I went to visit a friend of mine one day to see a new home he had just purchased. When arriving, I was amazed at all the land around it. When commenting on the beautiful property, he asked if I wanted to walk around and see some of it. I was amazed to find out it was all his! He had purchased over 80 acres of land. Therefore, he was in charge of it all and could come and go as he pleased. I think we sometimes forget that God owns all that we can see. He has no limitations. There is no place He cannot go. He is not waiting for an invitation. He owns it all. Therefore, you never have to wonder if the Lord is with you. He is always there because it is all already His to come and go as He pleases. Because He fills all the Earth with His presence, He is already there.
2026-08-24.application: Never, ever feel like God is not close to you.
2026-08-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being close.

2026-08-25.title: Think About the Lord
2026-08-25.verse: Within your temple we reflect on your loyal love, O God. The praise you receive as far away as the ends of the earth is worthy of your reputation, O God. You execute justice.
2026-08-25.observation: No one has to tell us to think about our problems and issues. They come in and occupy our minds with or without our permission. However, we have to discipline ourselves to think about the Lord. The word for meditate in this passage means that we do not just have a passing thought about the Lord. It means we consistently think about Him. We keep rolling around the goodness of God in our minds and consistently dwell on all He has done. When we do this, we begin to remember that our problems are not bigger than God. We remember all He has done in the past and all He is currently doing in our lives. Most of us have more of a reason to have hope than our current problems would like us to believe. Therefore, when we meditate on the Lord, we begin to realize that God is worthy of our worship.
2026-08-25.application: Take a few moments, shut out the problems, and focus on the Lord.
2026-08-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so easy to worship.

2026-08-26.title: Have Something that Lasts Beyond Death
2026-08-26.verse: Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich and his wealth multiplies. For he will take nothing with him when he dies; his wealth will not follow him down into the grave.
2026-08-26.observation: I once saw a picture of a hearse with a trailer attached to it. This instantly opened up a lot of questions, but also a great visual of what we can sometimes think. We all know we cannot take anything with us out of this life, yet we live like we can. We try to gain more and more until we eventually die of exhaustion. Now, I am not advocating that we live in the opposite way. We should do what we can to provide for our families and leave a legacy for our children. However, we must realize that there has to be a balance in our lives. Don’t be so busy trying to build a life that you forget to live your life serving others and investing in those around you. When we die, we do not take any of it with us.
2026-08-26.application: Spend time with someone today without expecting anything in return. Just enjoy life with others for a moment.
2026-08-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, that we may not take our stuff into eternity, but we have You for all eternity. Even better.

2026-08-27.title: Thankfulness Honors the Lord
2026-08-27.verse: Whoever presents a thank offering honors me. To whoever obeys my commands, I will reveal my power to deliver.
2026-08-27.observation: I’ll never forget sitting with some friends and inviting them into a rhythm our family enjoys while eating dinner together. We have trained ourselves to go around the table three times and say something for which we are grateful. Instead of doing it three times, we decided to do it once. The results were not so good. Several of the people at the table could not think of one thing to be thankful for and even started feeling uncomfortable. This became a reminder that thankfulness is not easy. Our brains are wired to assess threats and keep us safe. Therefore, to stop and be thankful takes intentionality and practice. We must always remember to slow down for thankfulness. God’s Word says it is a way to honor the Lord.
2026-08-27.application: Write out three things you are thankful for that have happened within the past week.
2026-08-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for doing more than we realize. We have to pause to truly begin to see all the good things You have done.

2026-08-28.title: Constantly Return to the Basics
2026-08-28.verse: Let me again experience the joy of your deliverance. Sustain me by giving me the desire to obey.
2026-08-28.observation: There is a famous legend among sports fans concerning one of the greatest coaches in football. His name was Vince Lombardi. The legend says he would look at all his men at the start of every summer practice and say, “Gentlemen, this is a football.” Even though he was talking to men who had likely played the game since they were children, Vince realized that the fundamentals were essential. Therefore, he would break down the game into its most basic parts and build from there. When it comes to our walk with God, we can sometimes forget the most fundamental principles of our faith. We can become so focused on other things we forget the simple joy of salvation. When we understand that we have been saved from our past sins, we are being saved in the present (also called sanctification), and being saved for the future (also called glorification), we can find joy in any season. On top of that joy, we can build the other habits to walk in freedom.
2026-08-28.application: Take a moment and think about the wonderful joy of being saved. Your sins are gone. You have been made new in Christ.
2026-08-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for saving us.

2026-08-29.title: The Eternal Justice of the Lord
2026-08-29.verse: For the music director, a well-written song by David. It was written when Doeg the Edomite went and informed Saul: “David has arrived at the home of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast about your evil plans, O powerful man? God’s loyal love protects me all day long.
2026-08-29.observation: One of the biggest questions Christians have to grapple with is what is called the “problem of evil.” The question is if God is good, why do bad things happen to good people? Another way of saying it is that if God is good, why does it seem like bad people get away with doing bad things? This goes to the heart of the human need for fairness and justice. St. Augustine had a great theodicy (defense of God) for this. His argument was to remind us that our view of justice only extends to this life. We can sometimes think that if someone is not judged before they die, they get away with their sin. However, God is eternal. To God, death is merely us changing location. Therefore, we do not have to worry about whether or not evil people are judged with righteous justice before they die. Death does not help them escape God’s eyes. He sees us and we can trust that, in eternity, God will see all things made just and right.
2026-08-29.application: Trust God’s justice over our own desire for fairness.
2026-08-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being trustworthy.

2026-08-31.title: Plan on God’s Faithfulness
2026-08-31.verse: I wish the deliverance of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores the well-being of his people, may Jacob rejoice, may Israel be happy!
2026-08-31.observation: When I was a kid, I would get so disappointed when plans would get changed. I loved going on trips or going to do things. Therefore, when plans would have to be altered I would become so upset. To combat this, my young mind decided to never trust any plan until it actually happened. This became a defense mechanism to stop disappointment. How many times do we all do that with the Lord? Even though He has come through so many times, we still are afraid to hope that He will do it again. Therefore, we do everything we can not to hope in Him until it happens. God’s Word tells us to do the opposite. We are to hope in Him, no matter what. We are to trust in Him because He always comes through. Therefore, plan on God being faithful just as He has always been.
2026-08-31.application: Live today as though God really will be with you in all things.
2026-08-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your faithfulness.
